privacy.title: Read in your browser
privacy.body: Your PDF is turned into text on your own device. The match score never touches a server.

privacy.title: Hidden before the AI
privacy.body: Name, email, phone, address, links and ID numbers are swapped for tags. You see exactly what's sent, and can hide more.

privacy.title: Nothing stored
privacy.body: No CVs, no results, no history. The only thing we count is how many AI runs you used today.

home.endBody: It takes about 30 seconds. No sign-in needed.

privacyPage.title: What happens to your CV
privacyPage.intro: Short version: your CV stays on your device, the AI only sees a version with your personal details hidden, and we store nothing about it.

sections.title: The match score runs in your browser
sections.body: When you drop a PDF, your browser reads its text with a library called pdf.js. Matching skills happens in the same page. Your file and its text are not uploaded anywhere for this.

sections.title: What the AI sees
sections.body: The AI tools need your CV text, so before anything is sent we replace your name, email, phone numbers, address, links and ID numbers with tags like [EMAIL-1]. You can click any other word to hide it too. The "What the AI will see" window shows the exact text we send. The real values are put back on your screen only.

sections.title: Which AI
sections.body: The AI runs on a provider chosen by the site's owner (currently Google Gemini's free tier). Free tiers may use what you send to improve their models, which is one more reason we hide your personal details first.

sections.title: What we store
sections.body: Nothing about your CV or results. For signed-in users we keep one counter per day (a random-looking account id and a number) so the free AI isn't abused. It expires within two days.

sections.title: Signing in
sections.body: Google or GitHub tells us an account id and your name. We keep your first name and that id in an encrypted cookie in your browser, to say hi and to count your daily runs. We don't keep your email address or photo.

sections.title: In your browser
sections.body: While you sign in, your job and CV text wait in this tab's session storage so you don't lose them. It's removed as soon as you're back, and it's gone when you close the tab.

sections.title: Questions
sections.body: JobFit is open source, so you can check all of this in the code on GitHub.
